name: Clarify Features
description: Turn rough ideas into finalized project specs through dense, voice-friendly clarification rounds, using the existing spec or agent loop when available.
intent_tags: turn stream of consciousness into finalized specs
use_when: A batch of ideas or dictated notes needs thorough clarification and finalized specifications grounded in the current project.
avoid_when: The task is implementing features or executing an agent loop rather than authoring specifications.
